## Welcome, Karthik! 👋

You've been invited to contribute to **Business Founder / Researcher** — a Hyderabad Business Radar that discovers newly launched MSME businesses every 8 hours using open-source tools.

### What this project does
- 🔍 Crawls Google Maps, Instagram, and OpenStreetMap every 8 hours
- 🗺️ Displays all Hyderabad businesses on an interactive MapLibre map
- 🤖 Enriches business data using Grok AI API
- 📊 Helps outreach teams find and contact new businesses before competitors

### Areas you can contribute to
- [ ] Python crawler agents (`/agents/`)
- [ ] Frontend map components (`/components/RadarMap.tsx`)
- [ ] Database schema improvements (`/supabase/migrations/`)
- [ ] GitHub Actions workflow tuning
- [ ] Business category classification

### Getting started
1. Clone the repo
2. Check `README.md` for setup instructions
3. Review the PRD: `tasks/prd-business-radar.md`
4. Pick any open issue and raise a PR!

Welcome aboard! 🚀
